title: Gigantic and useless
text: Gigantic and useless. This pillow is insanely huge. It is incredibly uncomfortable and not at all what I was expecting. It easily weighs 15 pounds. It’s not something you can take from your bedroom downstairs to your couch and even if you could you would have only inches of space on your couch to sit down because this thing is so gigantic. The neck roll pillow that it comes with is useless as well, it does not hold it’s shape and provides no support

product_metadata.title: Soothing Company Reading Pillow with Shredded Memory Foam, Backrest Pillow with Arm Pockets, Back Support Pillow for Sitting Up in Bed While Gaming, Books, TV (Standard-Navy Blue)
features: Shredded Memory Foam Filling - Light, breathable memory foam filling supports and conforms for optimal comfort.
Arm Pockets - Side pocket storage for remotes, books, bottles, phones, or other electronics and personal items.
Easy to Clean, Removable Cover - Made from super soft velour, pillow covers are machine washable for easy clean up.
Ideal for reading, watching TV, gaming, or laptop use. Curl up anywhere or enjoy added support while sitting upright in bed or lounging on the floor.

description: The Soothing Company Standard Reading Pillow

Get cozy with one of Soothing Company’s plush reading pillows. Our premium shredded memory foam filling cushions and conforms to your back while providing optimal support anytime, anywhere! A convenient handle makes it easy to tote this lightweight arm pillow to the bed, sofa, floor, out to the patio, or anywhere you wish to prop yourself up in a luxurious, wraparound hug. Soft, moldable foam and velvety velour help ease back pain as you work or lounge. Enjoy your pillow while watching TV, gaming, reading a book, or using a laptop. Use your new favorite accessory to relieve an aching back, elevate an injury, or even prop yourself up at night to reduce nasal congestion.

Designed for long-lasting, breathable support, our pillows come in two sizes to provide the perfect fit for children, teens, and adults. Handy side pockets allow quick access to remotes, books, bottles, phones, and other personal items. Our extra-large reading pillow includes not only pockets in both arms, but also a large back pocket, perfect for storing your favorite magazines or other documents.

Spills and stains? No problem! Our luxurious velour covers easily zip off and can be thrown in the washer for easy clean up. Whether curling up with a good book or spreading out for a craft, you can relax and breathe easy with our 3-year warranty. So go ahead, treat yourself and the whole family.

Pillows come compressed for optimal shipping. Fluff the pillow and place in a ventilated room for up to 48 hours to allow full expansion. Do not place memory foam in washer. To clean your pillow cover, remove from pillow and wash in warm or cold cycle. Tumble dry low.
